1.explanation: This snippet mounts a DatePicker2 in “showTime” mode and explicitly provides both a default date (2021-07-21) and a default time (09:00:00) via `timePanelProps.defaultValue`. When you open the calendar, you will see the left header correctly shows “2021年7月”, but the right header (time) will display “Invalid Date” – reproducing the issue demonstrated in the bug report screenshot. The `format: 'HH:mm:ss'` on the `timePanelProps` simply ensures the time columns and header expect that format.
1.bug_scenario: When using DatePicker2 in time‐enabled mode (`showTime`) and passing a default time via the `timePanelProps.defaultValue` property, the right‐hand header of the popup (the time header) renders as “Invalid Date” instead of the default time. In the screenshot you can see the calendar on the left shows “2021年7月”, but the time panel on the right shows “Invalid Date” above the hour/minute/second columns.
